hotels.title: Fiji Adults-Only Beachfront Pool Villas on Matamanoa Island with All-Inclusive Dining
hotels.description: Slip away to Matamanoa Island Resort, an adults-only paradise within a private island oasis, surrounded by glistening turquoise waters and soft white sands. Nestled amid lush greenery and swaying palms, this hidden gem is the island's only resort, drawing couples and honeymooners to experience secluded luxury in peaceful tropical surrounds. Indulge in unforgettable treatments at Nama Spa and enjoy all-inclusive dining at Vale Ni Blau Restaurant, where international and Fijian flavours shine. Relax on untouched tropical beaches, explore beautiful coral reefs just steps from your oceanfront villa and experience genuine Fijian hospitality. Spend your days discovering the Island's breathtaking surroundings with guided hikes, daily expeditions and snorkelling or scuba diving in the Pacific Ocean. Venture to the iconic Monuriki Island, known as the filming location of Cast Away, or stay onshore to learn about authentic Fijian customs and traditions, from coconut husking to tying sulus.
